summary: Teach lane collectives through participation and data ownership before relying on implicit lockstep intuition.
outcomes: Trace shuffle, vote and reduction-style lane operations.
Use valid masks and group scopes for participating threads.
sequence: Label lanes and values in a small warp view.
Trace data exchange and vote results.
Compare warp, block and cooperative-group scopes.
Test partial participation and divergent cases.

visual.question: Which lane supplies this value and is it a valid participant?
visual.interaction: Change the active set and step an exchange.

practice.task: Build a masked warp operation with boundary cases.
practice.success: Every read has a valid source lane and synchronization contract; behavior is verified on supported hardware.
